tonight.headline: Zvada's 2 is still the hole — nothing left to set
body: Bad news first: Dominic Zvada, added Thursday for Matt Gay, kicked 2.0 against Washington (archive); Gay plays at Las Vegas this afternoon and anything above 2.0 makes that swap a loss. The 49.96 you have banked is Daniels and Likely, not the kicker.

ESPN: 140.3 to 126.7, 58%, against the 9-0 Maye-day. The lineup as set is the projection lineup and no projected starter is in doubt — Taylor, Tuten, Golden, Rice and Gordon carry no designation. Garrett Wilson was cleared this morning (Rapoport via NBC 15 Nov) but sits on your bench, 0.6 behind Rice: a coin flip the projection takes. Nothing to do before kickoff.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Maye-day start Alvin Kamara (8.1) into New Orleans' first game with Travis Etienne back off IR (Yahoo 14 Nov) — a three-way split with Estime. KC Concepcion (10.6) loses a little if Denzel Boston plays, and Fowler expects he will (DraftSharks 15 Nov). Smith-Njigba (22.4) and Bowers (15.5) carry their projection.

case.label: Why Rice, not Wilson
case.body: 13.4 against 12.8 is inside the two-point line, where even ESPN is right 56% of the time. Wilson's clearance is what the 12.8 already assumed — priced. Take the projection and write no thesis.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A surprise inactive among Taylor, Tuten, Gordon, Golden or Rice at 10:30 CDMX — none has a designation (NFL.com Week 10). Then Marks (14.2) or Wilson (12.8) fills in. This run is before the official lists.

whatWentWrong.title: The kicker stream cost points before Sunday began
whatWentWrong.lead: Zvada for Gay on a 10.7-to-8.3 projection; the projection then fell to 8.1, and Zvada kicked 2.0.

case.label: What happened
case.body: The brief recommended Zvada as a free agent Wednesday; the add was made Thursday 13:16Z. By 22:05Z ESPN had cut him to 8.1 against Gay's 8.3 with no reporting found to explain it. Thursday: 2.0 (archive).

case.label: The rule it bent
case.body: STRATEGY §5: a stream needs a real gap, not a marginal one. 2.4 projected points on a kicker was marginal, and the slot changed for it.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Gay scores 2.0 or less Sunday — then the swap ties or wins and closes RIGHT. Anything more closes it WRONG on the outcome. Either way: no kicker stream under a 3-point gap for the rest of the season.
